industry: Restaurants & Food Service — ERP SaaS
business_description: PlateSync ERP is a restaurant operations dashboard. The core product is an admin panel where the restaurant owner manages their menu: categories, items, and sub-items (modifiers/add-ons) each with prices. Owners can add, edit, and organize dishes, set base prices, attach sub-items like size or toppings with their own prices, and see a clear menu tree. Keep the MVP focused on this menu management workflow — not a full multi-module enterprise suite.

industry: Art
business_description:
Build a React website for an online art gallery where a single owner (artist/curator) can showcase and manage their paintings. 
Overall Aesthetic
Warm, boutique, and luxurious — think a small high-end private gallery, not a sterile museum. Use a beige/cream base palette with warm neutrals (ivory, sand, taupe) accented with soft gold or brass tones for borders, buttons, dividers, and hover states. Add subtle texture (linen or paper grain feel via soft shadows and layering) rather than flat color blocks. Typography: elegant serif for all headings and painting titles, clean sans-serif for body text and metadata. Generous whitespace, soft transitions, and slow tasteful hover animations on artwork cards.
Public-Facing Pages
1.	Home — Full-bleed hero section featuring a rotating selection of paintings marked as "Featured" by the admin, with the gallery name/logo, a short tagline, and a CTA button leading to the Gallery page. Below the hero, show a "Recent Works" section with the latest 4–6 paintings added.
2.	Gallery / Collection page — Masonry or grid layout of painting cards. Each card shows the artwork image, title, and price. On hover, reveal medium and year. Include filter controls (by category, availability status) and sort controls (by year, price) styled with the warm beige/gold aesthetic — no default browser dropdowns. Clicking a card goes to the painting detail page.
3.	Painting detail page — Large painting image with zoom on click. Below or beside it, display a "gallery label" style specs card with: title, description, medium, dimensions (H × W × D in cm), physical weight (in kg), year created, price, and availability status (Available / Sold / On Hold). Include an "Inquire about this piece" CTA button that navigates to the Contact page and pre-fills the message field with the painting's title.
4.	About page — Artist/owner bio with a photo and a short gallery story section.
5.	Contact page — Form with fields: name, email, and message. The message field should be pre-fillable via URL query param (e.g. ?subject=Inquiry about: [Painting Title]) so the "Inquire" button on the detail page works correctly.
Admin Dashboard (Owner Only)
•	Protected route at /admin. Unauthenticated users are redirected to /admin/login.
•	/admin/login shows only a sign-in form — no sign-up, no registration. New accounts cannot be created from the UI.
•	The single admin account is created 
•	Admin dashboard includes: 
o	A table/list of all paintings with columns for title, category, price, availability, featured (toggle), and quick delete.
o	An "Add Painting" button opening a full form with fields: title, image upload (with live preview before saving), description, medium, dimensions (H, W, D separately), weight, year, price, category, tags, availability status, and featured toggle.
o	Each painting in the list has an "Edit" action that opens the same form pre-filled with existing data.
o	Image upload

industry: Fine art gallery · original oil paintings · artist portfolio
business_description: Jeanne Kassab Art is a personal fine art gallery for original paintings — abstract landscapes and layered oils made by hand in Lebanon. Collectors browse one-of-a-kind works online, open each painting for details and price, and message Jeanne on WhatsApp to inquire or reserve a piece. The site is the public face of the studio: brand-first hero, a living gallery of latest works, an about page for the artist, and a direct path to conversation — not a booking SaaS or ops dashboard.
